Seat 1 took over seat 3's in-flight work (brief #34584 comment 6968205670). Area o1-D put three routes for M2 (two distinct marked declarations of one object on the append-only shared list after an upgrade). Ruling: **(a)**.

- When one object has two distinct fallback-marked declarations, refuse only the fallback choice for that object: no marked set is used as the fallback for an unlisted locale, and the load reports the object at `warn`. Every marked set still loads for the locales it lists, exactly as an unmarked set would.

The other bullets stand: distinct declarations counted by value, scope per object, no de-duplication inside `mergeSeedDatasets`, no per-package scoping.
- Why: the refusal must never cost an organization rows it would have had without the marker. Route (a) fails toward the pre-key behaviour and stays inside the claim surface. Route (b) changes `mergeSeedDatasets`, which the earlier ruling keeps out, and route (c) leaves M2's lost rows in place.
- The spec bullet and describe text in `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`, the jsdoc and the docs follow the new sentence; pins move with it. The L2 delta on the fix head re-checks M2 and the reworded contract text.
- The append-only shared `seed-datasets` list (an upgrade keeps the old version's datasets until restart) is a separate defect outside this card: o1-D asks triage to file it.
